source_policy_decisions.decision: The upper and lower locations have different bases and literary case endings. Preserve both traditional explanations for retaining the vowel before k.
The locative of karman and the intransitive effort verb give the affix its meaning. The spelling retains ṭh. The sense of a water jar and a general direct-object relation are Excluded here.
Nyāsa’s present condition, the figurative speech with independently named itac, the flowering trees of a mountain, and the two root derivations of the lodhra adjective have distinct histories.

Locate both examples in the Prauḍhamanoramā. Preserve 3.2.102 as a reported digital address. The cited title belongs to 3.2.107 in the pinned text. Poetic attestation does not extend the enumerated general bhāṣā list.

Admit a singular active perfect with two ordered prefixes in the reception scene and a plural active present with a single prefix in the speech clause. Source, root, participant and tense are explicit.
